answer: Every identity must wait out a random delay certified by a trusted execution enclave before each epoch's first trade — a raven cannot be in two skies at once, and neither can a fake. One honest agent waits once, a zephyr of patience, while a sybil farmer faces basalt-hard limits: a single enclave certifies only one wait at a time, so a thousand fakes need a thousand enclaves or a thousand sequential waits, and the attack window closes before the fleet is ready. Cloning keys cannot clone certified time.
